Synthetic, analyst-specified biochemical ODE model; not a published paper.
Time t is in minutes. States are dimensionless abstract activities. The fixed compartment has size 1 dimensionless.
Initial U = 1.0.
Initial V = 0.1.
Parameter k1 = 0.2. The parameter table labels k1 per second, but the equally authoritative equation legend labels k1 per minute. No correction is available.
Parameter k2 = 0.15.
Equation dU/dt = -k1*U.
Equation dV/dt = k1*U-k2*V.
